title: 品格教育：誠實
footer: Teacher Dom · Character Education: Honesty 品格教育：誠實

slides.eyebrow_zh: 跟 Dom 老師上品格教育

strip.en: words that take courage: “It was me.”
strip.zh: 個需要勇氣的字：「是我做的。」

strip.en: lie can break a lot of trust
strip.zh: 個謊言，就能打破很多信任

lines.en: I have been teaching students in Taiwan for a couple of years.
lines.zh: 我在台灣教學生已經有幾年了。

slides.ask_en: Hands up: who has ever told a tiny lie?
slides.ask_zh: 舉手：誰曾經說過一個小小的謊？

slides.ask_en: In English we say: “Honesty is the best policy.” Is there a saying like that in Chinese?
slides.ask_zh: 英文有一句話：「誠實為上策。」中文有沒有類似的說法？

slides.body_en: Honesty means telling the truth — even when we make a mistake, and even when no one is watching.
slides.body_zh: 誠實就是說實話——就算自己做錯了，就算沒有人在看。

prompts.en: Stand up if you have ever broken something by accident.
prompts.zh: 曾經不小心弄壞東西的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if it was hard to say “It was me.”
prompts.zh: 覺得說出「是我做的」很難的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if you felt better after you told the truth.
prompts.zh: 說了實話之後覺得比較輕鬆的，站起來。

slides.punch_en: Telling the truth takes courage. That is why it matters.
slides.punch_zh: 說實話需要勇氣。所以它才重要。

items.en: Changing the score when you lose
Saying “I don't know” when you don't
items.zh: 不會的時候說「我不知道」

slides.note_en: Thumbs up for HONEST, thumbs down for NOT HONEST!
slides.note_zh: 誠實比讚，不誠實比倒讚！

slides.q_en: You find NT$100 on the playground. Nobody saw you. What do you do?
slides.q_zh: 你在操場撿到 100 元，沒有人看到。你會怎麼做？
slides.explain_en: Take it to a teacher. Honesty is what you do when no one is watching.
slides.explain_zh: 交給老師。沒有人在看的時候你怎麼做，才是誠實。

slides.q_en: Your team scores the winning point — but you saw the ball go out. What does honesty look like?
slides.q_zh: 你們這隊拿下致勝的一分——但你看到球出界了。誠實的做法是什麼？

options.en: Tell the referee it was out

slides.explain_en: Tell the referee. A win you did not earn is not really a win.
slides.explain_zh: 告訴裁判。不是自己贏來的勝利，不算真的贏。

slides.q_en: A boy shouts “Wolf!” for fun — twice. The third time, a real wolf comes. What happens?
slides.q_zh: 一個男孩喊「狼來了！」喊著玩——喊了兩次。第三次，狼真的來了。結果呢？
slides.explain_en: Nobody believes him. Every lie spends a little trust — and trust is hard to earn back.
slides.explain_zh: 沒有人相信他。每說一次謊，就花掉一點信任——而信任很難賺回來。

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: A small lie is OK if nobody finds out.
items.zh: 小小的謊，只要沒人發現就沒關係。
items.note_en: YOU know. And small lies grow.
items.note_zh: 你自己知道。而且小謊會越變越大。

items.en: Being honest means saying every unkind thing you think.
items.zh: 誠實就是把心裡每一句不好聽的話都說出來。
items.note_en: Be honest AND kind: choose true words that help.
items.note_zh: 誠實，也要善良：選擇真實又有幫助的話。

items.note_en: Yes — and it is where learning starts.
items.note_zh: 對——而且學習就是從這裡開始的。

items.en: Doing your own work is part of honesty.
items.zh: 自己完成作業，也是誠實的一部分。
items.note_en: Your work should show what YOU really know.
items.note_zh: 作業應該呈現「你」真正會的。

slides.prompt_en: When is it hard to tell the truth?
slides.sentence_en: It is hard to be honest when ______.
slides.sentence_zh: 當 ______ 的時候，要誠實很難。
slides.time_en: One minute each. Then I will ask two of you.
slides.time_zh: 每人一分鐘。然後我會請兩位分享。

slides.note_en: Watch closely — what gets spilled at the start?
slides.note_zh: 仔細看——一開始打翻了什麼？

slides.q_en: In Dom's cartoon, what was spilled?
slides.q_zh: 在 Dom 的動畫裡，打翻的是什麼？
slides.explain_en: Paint! And the student was brave enough to say what happened.
slides.explain_zh: 顏料！而且那位同學勇敢地說出發生了什麼事。

slides.head_en: 3 Honest Things to Do This Week
slides.head_zh: 這週可以做的 3 件誠實的事

items.en: When you make a mistake, say “It was me” right away.
items.zh: 做錯事的時候，馬上說「是我做的」。

items.en: Do your own work — even when it is hard.
items.zh: 自己完成作業——就算很難。
把功勞歸給對的人：「那是 ______ 的點子。」

slides.head_en: One More Thing: Honest with the Ocean
slides.head_zh: 還有一件事：對海洋誠實
slides.body_en: Honesty is not only words. It also means we do not pretend we cannot see. So let's be honest: where does my trash really go?
slides.body_zh: 誠實不只是說話，也是不假裝沒看見。所以我們誠實地問：我丟掉的垃圾，到底去了哪裡？

slides.q_en: A plastic bottle is dropped near a ditch in Changhua. Where can it end up?
slides.q_zh: 一個寶特瓶被丟在彰化的水溝邊。它最後可能到哪裡？
slides.explain_en: The ocean. Ditches join rivers, and rivers reach the sea — where Changhua's rare white dolphins live.
slides.explain_zh: 海裡。水溝接到河，河流到海——那裡住著彰化外海稀有的白海豚。

slides.note_en: SDG 14 in one minute. What can YOU do for the ocean?
slides.note_zh: 一分鐘認識 SDG 14。「你」可以為海洋做什麼？

slides.head_en: My Honest Promise to the Ocean

lines.en: I put my trash where it belongs.
lines.zh: 我把垃圾丟到該丟的地方。

lines.en: If I see it, I pick it up.
I do not pretend I did not see.

slides.body_en: Go to our School Tour page and find the Tachu Elementary column. No sign-up, no login — just write your comment for Teacher Dom.
slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到大竹國小那一欄，免註冊、免登入，直接留言跟 Teacher Dom 互動。

slides.big_zh: 要勇敢、要公平，選擇誠實。
